entries.title: The Last Starship
entries.definitive_edition: The Last Starship on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native desktop release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Last Starship is a 2D space construction/simulation game from Introversion Software, with Steam Workshop, level-editor support, and a February 3, 2026 release after a 2023 Early Access launch. It supports Windows and macOS. No console, Linux, or mobile release was found in this pass, so Windows PC is the preferred archive route for capture/settings control, with macOS as a native desktop alternative.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC Steam release. Use Workshop/ship-sharing material as separate archive notes, and use macOS only as a native convenience alternative.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC release with Steam Workshop, level editor, and the strongest capture/settings path.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest practical archive route among sourced platforms.
secondary: content-valid desktop route, but Windows PC remains the main capture target.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content was found across the native desktop routes.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or definitive edition split was found; use the latest patched Steam build.
